match13-decision-audit.purpose: Read-only existing CPU probability diagnostics; not new training, deployed fusion, or final validation.
limits: All inputs are existing calibration evidence used for development.
Oracle uses truth solely to estimate complementarity and is not implementable inference.
Argmax summaries omit acceptance thresholds; native forceUncertain is not honored in this diagnostic upper-bound calculation.
Missing evidence counts as failure. Equal fusion requires all members available.
Fusion may exceed CPU budget and has not been reimplemented or measured.
match13-decision-audit.nextObjectiveIfLayerProbeFails: Separate phone identity learning from known-error validity: pretrain component cross entropy only on expert-correct component labels, then add a target-conditioned validity head with real expert negatives and balanced one-component counterfactual negatives, normalized per audio root. Keep correct/negative branches separate so rare-error suppression does not distort normalized phone identity distribution. Compare to signed-softmax baseline, never invent actual phone labels for expert-error rows, use calibration only for selection. This is a hypothesis, not an observed improvement.

trainingObjectiveAudit.evidence: Readout component_loss balances correct and error means in each batch. SenseVoice fine-tuning balances the entire natural-corpus positive/error classes with inverse-frequency weights, and selects checkpoints by balanced signed CTC loss. These are intentional imbalance protections, not demonstrated bugs. But they couple phone identity normalization to sparse negative-only labels, and could reduce identification generalization; test separated identity/validity heads rather than silently weakening expert-error supervision.
trainingObjectiveAudit.priorTargetComparison: HanziFlow native-CTC summary validity head already implemented. Actual full CPU fine-tuned comparison: 843 accepted,342 explicitReject,1054 abstention /2239; near-neighbor falseAccept218/2239. Do not repeat the same fixed CTC-summary architecture as if new.

conclusion.scopeLimitation: No qualifying new corpus verified among the candidates below; this is not a claim that none exists anywhere.
conclusion.closestAdditionalNaturalErrorCandidate: EdUHK spoken corpus of Hong Kong learners of Mandarin
conclusion.importantDistinction: EdUHK explicitly permits acknowledged research use and has public audio links. This is narrower than a verified standard open data license or a clear grant for trained-model redistribution. It must not be described as inaccessible or as having no permission at all.
conclusion.correctOnlySupplement: Tone Perfect has unusually strong published human review, but the current official access and rights do not establish a fixed freely downloadable open-license package.
conclusion.existingGateUnchanged: OMPAL calibration expert onset 18 roots / 4 speakers and rime 16 / 4 remain below frozen 100 roots / 5 speakers. Correct-only speech or target-swapped comparisons cannot fill these observed natural-error strata.

candidates.name: Spoken corpus of Hong Kong learners of Mandarin
candidates.actualLabelEvidence: Publisher describes consonant/vowel/tonal/retroflex-final and mispronunciation annotations from two trained listeners, third native Mandarin adjudicator for disagreement. Feature list includes l-to-n, p-to-b, x-to-q, eng-to-en, and tone substitutions. The pages use interactive feature filters; machine-readable all-token annotation extraction was not yet validated.
candidates.licenseStatus: Explicit publisher permission for research with acknowledgement; no standard open data license located on inspected pages; do not infer unlimited reuse or model redistribution.

candidates.name: Tone Perfect: Multimodal Database for Mandarin Chinese
candidates.actualLabelEvidence: Project authors report 410 syllable bases x four tones x six Beijing native student voices = 9840 isolated tokens, 3 male / 3 female. Project lead and native coach checked tone and pronunciation during recording; native research members independently reviewed processed sets, problem tokens were rerecorded; about 10 percent rerecorded. This is direct human quality review, not expected-text-only labeling.
candidates.licenseStatus: Original audio rights statement: In Copyright - Educational Use Permitted. Article says whole-set access requires noncommercial/educational request through repository team/Qualtrics and approval. Do not transfer the article license or third-party CC BY claims to the audio.
candidates.downloadStatus: Official homepage direct urllib GET returned HTTP403; web retrieval timed out. Article documents individual downloads and approved full-set transfer, but no current fixed direct package URL or audio SHA was verified. No login/request/audio download.

candidates.name: iCALL corpus
candidates.actualLabelEvidence: I2R authors describe 90841 utterances, 305 adults aged18-52, 142 hours; two rounds of actual Pinyin/tone transcription, second-round refined 77895 utterances and marked perceptually ambiguous decisions with an asterisk.
candidates.licenseStatus: No public audio license located in official paper or targeted searches. Paper publication permission is not an audio license.
candidates.downloadStatus: No fixed public direct audio/annotation inventory or download was verified; no author request sent.

candidates.name: BLCU inter-Chinese speech corpus, Japanese L1 subset
candidates.actualLabelEvidence: Primary experiment describes 4631 utterances from17 Japanese learners and well-trained phonetician mispronunciation ground truth, with reported speaker-disjoint train/test.
candidates.licenseStatus: No explicit open audio license verified.
candidates.downloadStatus: No fixed public download inventory verified; no contact made.

candidates.name: Global Accent Chinese
candidates.actualLabelEvidence: Official indexed description advertises typical phonetic-error descriptions and audio spanning syllables, words and sentences; detailed source metadata and annotation agreement were not established.
candidates.licenseStatus: No explicit open audio license verified.
candidates.downloadStatus: Official page direct web fetch timed out; no versioned inventory or audio retrieved.

candidates.name: ManDi (already evaluated in repository)
candidates.actualLabelEvidence: Regional and standard Mandarin productions with word/phone boundaries. These are not expert correct/error verdicts for all components; regional productions cannot be relabeled as mistakes.
candidates.licenseStatus: CC BY-NC 3.0, existing fixed source in repository.
